source_summary: Queried 20 GitHub Search API surfaces saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_17_api/. Deduplicated the search responses into all_candidates.json and audited 25 shortlisted repositories through GitHub repository/root/README API saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_17_readmes/. Selection prioritized runnable product surfaces, explicit agent workflows, local-first control, evidence/readback, MCP/CLI/UI entrypoints, hardware or browser control paths, and documented install/demo/test surfaces.
trend_observations: The strongest new projects are moving below the chat layer into controlled execution: cheaper computer-use loops, physical iPad/iOS control, local cognitive memory, browser instrumentation, code-review dashboards, evidence contracts, and policy/sandbox gateways. The radar should keep separating agent can act from agent can prove what happened: several projects now ship screenshots, dashboards, tests, receipts, CI gates, or human checkpoints as product primitives rather than afterthoughts.
assumptions: Scores are based on live GitHub Search API snapshots and selected repository/root/README audits. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, mobile-tested, hardware-tested, MCP-connected, credential-tested, provider-tested, security-tested, payment-tested, email-tested, education-system-tested, game-engine-tested, or deployed locally. Star/fork counts are raw GitHub metadata at collection time and are weak signals for very new repositories. Mature repositories already covered by prior radar runs were not repeated in Top unless this window showed a materially new product signal.
markdown_report:
# Daily AI Native Product Radar - 2026-09-17

Top 10 projects focus on controlled agent execution: low-cost macOS computer-use, physical iPad/iPhone control, self-improving game agents, persistent memory, human-gated local workbenches, iOS Simulator MCP control, structured code review, harness-to-LLM bridging, acceptance infrastructure, and deterministic tool-evidence checks. Watchlist tracks issue triage, DSH MCP management, MCP delegation, sandbox gateways, local research workspaces, literature monitoring, and GitHub Actions fan-out. No third-party repository was cloned or run; judgments are based on GitHub metadata plus repository/root/README audits saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_17_api/ and /tmp/radar_2026_09_17_readmes/.

top_projects.summary: Python computer-use loop that OCRs the screen, classifies next actions with TypeSafe, and clicks on macOS while targeting roughly $0.0002 per step.
top_projects.audience: Builders experimenting with practical computer-use agents where per-step cost, typed action choices, and local macOS control matter.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Turns GUI control into bounded typed decisions over OCR/screen state instead of generic free-form tool calls.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-16 and pushed minutes later; GitHub metadata showed 91 stars during audit. Root audit found .env.example, docs, tests, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, and typesafe_computer_use.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from Python package layout, CI badge, tests, env example, and docs; no Accessibility permissions, OCR loop, TypeSafe model call, or clicking was executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Run only in a disposable macOS desktop session and inspect action typing, permission prompts, and failure behavior before allowing real app control.

top_projects.summary: Controls an iPad through native screen sharing plus a USB HID input device, with support notes for USB-C iPhones.
top_projects.audience: Computer-use researchers who need agents to drive real mobile hardware instead of simulators or browser mocks.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Bridges agent commands to real touchscreen hardware through a control server, native app, and microcontroller input path.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-15, pushed 2026-09-16, and showed 54 stars. Root audit found control_server, input_device, ipad_app, docs, package files, security notes, and README demo GIF.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from three-component architecture and hardware docs; no iPad app, USB HID device, screen stream, or AssistiveTouch path was tested.
top_projects.recommended_action: Promote only after a repeatable hardware checklist and a safety boundary for unintended taps.

top_projects.summary: Local LLM plays RimWorld through a mod-exposed HTTP engine and rewrites its own skills, tools, and playbook between colonies.
top_projects.audience: Game AI builders and agent-memory researchers looking for long-horizon embodied task loops with inspectable state.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Combines game-engine verbs, world diffs, persisted markdown skills, tools, notes, and post-run learning into an agentic gameplay loop.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-16, pushed 2026-09-17, and showed 30 stars. Root audit found agent, brain, mod, mod-steward, config, docs, and scripts.
top_projects.runnability: Medium from clear C#/agent/mod split and tested-model notes; no RimWorld install, mod bridge, vLLM model, or colony run was executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Watch for replayable benchmark colonies and failure logs before treating self-improvement claims as proven.

top_projects.category: Persistent memory layer for coding agents
top_projects.summary: Self-hosted cognitive memory layer for Cursor, Claude, VS Code, and coding agents, with gateway, MCP, orchestrator, pipelines, studio, examples, Docker, and tests.
top_projects.audience: Developers who want agent memory to survive sessions and become reviewable infrastructure.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Makes architecture decisions, preferences, and prior work a shared memory product with MCP and studio surfaces rather than hidden chat history.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-16, pushed 2026-09-17, and showed 17 stars. Root audit found Dockerfile, docker-compose, requirements, gateway, layers, mcp, orchestrator, pipelines, studio, examples, and tests.
top_projects.runnability: High from self-hosted packaging and multiple runtime surfaces; no memory ingestion, MCP client, Docker stack, or studio UI was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Test with synthetic project history and require human review before memory is re-injected into future agent sessions.

top_projects.summary: Windows-first local AI agent workbench that can see and act on the user's computer, with every step requiring user confirmation.
top_projects.audience: Users who want a visible, local operator agent rather than a cloud automation black box.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Treats supervision as part of the product: local execution, step confirmation, skills gallery, market, engine, docs, and a launcher batch file.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-16, pushed 2026-09-17, and showed 4 stars. Root audit found engine, skills-gallery, market, docs, bilingual README, CI, and launcher batch file.
top_projects.runnability: Medium from launcher and engine structure; no Windows desktop run, agent action, or confirmation loop was tested.
top_projects.recommended_action: Keep the human-confirmation model, then verify whether skills can be audited before installation.

top_projects.category: iOS Simulator MCP control and viewer
top_projects.summary: Mirrors and drives the iOS Simulator from Claude Code, CLI agents, or a browser, with live viewer, cursor tracking, token-efficient snapshots, and MCP automation.
top_projects.audience: Mobile developers who need agents to inspect and operate iOS Simulator flows with visual proof.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Packages simulator UI state, cursor/action tracking, MCP protocol, viewer, benchmarks, examples, and tests as an agent control layer.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-15, pushed 2026-09-16, and showed 2 stars. Root audit found .claude-plugin, viewer, protocol, plugins, benchmarks, examples, packaging, src, tests, and server.json.
top_projects.runnability: High from Python package, uv lockfile, CI badge, examples, tests, and MCP metadata; no simulator, viewer, or MCP client was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Use a toy iOS app and compare UI snapshot token cost against screenshot-only approaches.

top_projects.summary: Staged TypeSafe Jev code-review workflow that reviews diffs or whole codebases and displays focused results in a quiet local dashboard.
top_projects.audience: Engineers who want bounded LLM review passes with inspectable evidence selection rather than one huge prompt.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Uses typed model judgments, risk matrix stages, evidence selection, and a local dashboard to make review reasoning easier to inspect.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-16, pushed 2026-09-17, and showed 7 stars. Root audit found .env.example, docs, dashboard screenshot, package files, scripts, src, and TypeScript config.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from package structure and dashboard artifact; no model key, diff review, full-codebase scan, or dashboard session was executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Run on a small synthetic diff with known defects and compare against existing lint/test findings.

top_projects.summary: CLI-first, adapter-first framework that lets a stronger LLM act as the reasoning brain behind harnesses such as DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Codex, and Claude Code.
top_projects.audience: Power users who want to decouple best reasoning model from the agent harness they prefer operating.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Defines an A2L protocol, adapters, apps, examples, skills, docs, and tests around model/harness collaboration.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-16, pushed 2026-09-17, and showed 2 stars. Root audit found apps, packages, skills, examples, docs, tests, package files, and bilingual README.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from workspace structure and protocol docs; no harness adapter, model bridge, or Codex/Claude integration was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Test with a no-op harness adapter first and inspect handoff logs for prompt leakage or authority confusion.

top_projects.summary: Browser-runnable acceptance MVP where parties agree on done criteria, check delivery, and pay by compiled contract rules.
top_projects.audience: Builders exploring agent marketplaces, milestone payments, or verifiable delivery contracts.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Turns agent completed the work into rules, fixtures, tests, contracts, and browser-executed verification instead of trust in a transcript.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-15 and pushed 2026-09-16. Root audit found .env.example, contracts, docs, fixtures, scripts, source, tests, Vite and Vitest configs, plus a published browser demo link.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from tests, contract fixtures, and browser demo claim; no Ethereum VM tab, contract, transaction, or payment flow was executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Use as a conceptual reference for agent-delivery acceptance, but keep real payments out until dispute paths and identities are clearer.

top_projects.category: Deterministic evidence contracts for tool-using agents
top_projects.summary: Pure-Python verifier that checks LLM tool results and exact scalar claims before agents claim success.
top_projects.audience: Agent developers who need local guardrails against hallucinated tool outputs, null-as-zero errors, or redacted values presented as facts.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Defines claim/evidence contracts as deterministic code so agent answers can be checked against actual tool returns.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-16, pushed 2026-09-17, and showed 1 star. Root audit found examples, tests, package metadata, README in English/Spanish, and tool_evidence_guard.
top_projects.runnability: High from zero-runtime-dependency positioning, tests, and examples; no verifier was run against live tool traces.
top_projects.recommended_action: Wire it to one existing automation output where scalar counts matter, such as snapshot importedRuns/projects/historyEntries.
